name: Shockwave
description: On a dry lake bed the subject punches the ground and a ring of debris blasts outward.

wardrobe.man: a sleeveless black top, black cargo trousers and combat boots
wardrobe.woman: a sleeveless black top, black cargo trousers and combat boots
wardrobe.person: a sleeveless black top, black cargo trousers and combat boots

scene_prompt: Create a new cinematic film still in {aspect_words} format. The {subject} from the reference images is the only person in it: keep {their} exact face, eyes, nose, jaw, hairline and hairstyle, skin tone and build{identity_notes}. Take only the face and hair from the references; the clothing, background and lighting are all new. The {subject} kneels on one knee in the middle of a vast cracked dry lake bed at sunset, right fist pulled back, facing the camera, wearing {wardrobe}. The ground is a pale mosaic of dry clay plates, distant mountains sit on the horizon under an orange and violet sky, and a little dust drifts in the air. Low-angle wide shot from ground level six metres away, the {subject} centered, full body visible. Cinematic photography, warm low sun from the left, long shadows, golden dust. Correct human anatomy, natural skin texture, sharp focus on the {subject}, untouched desert ground and a clean horizon throughout.
effect_prompt: Use the provided start image as the first frame. The {subject} ALREADY kneels with the fist pulled back, eyes on a point just past the camera. The fist slams into the ground, and a perfectly circular shockwave blasts outward from the impact: a ring of lifted clay plates, dust and small rocks races across the lake bed in every direction, the air ripples with a visible distortion wave, and the ground cracks open in radiating lines, the ring passing under and past the camera. The camera shakes once with the impact, then holds. Sound: a deep booming impact, a rolling rumble, debris and dust rushing past. Photorealistic, cinematic visual effects, shockwave physics with real debris and dust, sharp detail, stable picture.
generic_prompt: Use the provided start image as the first frame. The {subject} in the frame slams a fist into the ground, and a perfectly circular shockwave blasts outward from the impact: a ring of dust and debris races out in every direction, the air ripples with a visible distortion wave and the ground cracks in radiating lines. The camera keeps the same framing and the same movement it already has. Sound: a deep booming impact, a rolling rumble, debris rushing past. Photorealistic, cinematic visual effects, shockwave physics with real debris and dust, sharp detail, stable picture.
